entity.description: A product's publication in a store (impl-commerce P3, §4; design-commerce §4), effective dated as ProductStoreCategory is: publishing starts a row from a date, withdrawal ends it, a change of template, badge or rank is a new row. A virtual product's published row covers its saleable variants; a variant is left out by its own exclusion row (PspkExcluded). A row with no kind is published (rows made before P3). Read the current row (fromDate at or before the time, thruDate after it or empty), never by the store and product alone. StoreMerchandisingServices writes it; get#StorePublication answers what is public.

field.name: templateKey
field.description: The theme's product template for this product in the store (Shop's theme release names the keys); empty for the theme's default.

field.name: changeReason
field.description: Why the row was started or ended, on rows written before the reason went to each field's audit row (F63); no longer written.

field.name: itemDescription
field.description: Description for the OrderItem (itemDescription), plain text: a promo service puts it on its items as written and never expands it as a template, and a ${ in it is refused by store#Promotion and needs DATABASE_ADMIN to write (StorePromotion.eecas.xml; SEC-BAP-83)

field.name: serviceRegisterId
field.description: Registered Service of type ProductStorePromotion that implements the mantle.product.PromotionServices.apply#Promotion interface

field.name: changeReason
field.description: Why the setting was started or ended (the checkout policy names its reason, impl-commerce P6; the store's History shows it).

Relationship between the ProductStore and DataDocument Entities meant to replace ProductStore.productDataDocumentId fields and the like. See: https://forum.moqui.org/t/productstore-datadocument-options/303.

A local shipping rate of a store: the charge for an order part going to a destination zone (a Geo, often a group of GAT_GROUP_MEMBER members: it matches when it is one of the address's geos, from get#PostalAddressGeoIdSet, or a group holding one), optionally for one carrier and method, within a weight band and a value band (each lower bound inclusive, upper bound exclusive, empty for none), in its currency, from a date. Among the rules that match, the lowest priority number wins; rules of the same priority whose zone, method, bands and dates overlap are refused. A store with a rule in effect now or later is rated by its rules: no matching rule means no delivery, never free shipping; a store with none keeps Mantle's local default. A change ends the rule and starts its successor.

field.name: geoId
field.description: The destination zone.

field.name: carrierPartyId
field.description: Empty for any carrier.

field.name: shipmentMethodEnumId
field.description: Empty for any method.

field.name: shippingAmount
field.description: The charge for the part.

field.name: previousRateId
field.description: The rule this one replaced from its start.

entity.description: The fulfillment of one digital line of an approved Shop order (a StoreCheckout's): its step (StoreItemFulfillmentStep: pending, invoiced, paid, completed, held when the capture did not succeed, revoked after a refund or return) with the marker of each step done (the invoice, the capture and finalization, the part's completion, the grants), the tries and the last safe failure. One row per order line; a retry resumes at the first step not done, so no second invoice, capture or grant is made.

field.name: recipientPartyId
field.description: The order part's customer, who the grant is for.

field.name: paidDate
field.description: The payment captured and the invoice finalized.

field.name: completedDate
field.description: The part completed and the grants issued.

field.name: noticeDate
field.description: The download-ready notice handed to the delivery ledger.

entity.description: A recipient's entitlement to one downloadable file (a ProductContent of type PcntDownload, its version the content's own) of a settled order line, from the line's fulfillment: from and thru dates, the revocation with its reason (StoreDownloadRevokeReason: a refund, a return's settlement, a chargeback, staff), and the use count. The file's location is read from the ProductContent at each download and never kept or answered here. It follows its recipient through merge#Parties.

field.name: versionText
field.description: The file's version when granted (the content's sequence and date), shown to the buyer.

entity.description: A registered connector a store may be bound through: its message type, the kind of business message it carries, its direction and the mapping versions StoreChannels.js implements. Only a registered, enabled connector with a handler in StoreChannels.js is offered; disabling one stops its intake (the messages are kept).

field.name: messageKind
field.description: The business message (docType): ChannelOrder; EdiX12 for an EDI partner, whose documents are the EDI services'

field.name: direction
field.description: in, out or both

field.name: mappingVersion
field.description: The current mapping version a new binding takes

field.name: managedBy
field.description: Empty when a store's channel operator binds it; edi when the binding is the EDI administrator's (an EdiConnection), which Commerce only reads and retries

moqui.basic.Enumeration.description: Channel orders, CSV (one row per line)

entity.description: A product feed of a store (find#StoreFeeds, store#StoreFeed): its Shop site, a registered format and destination (StoreFeeds.js formats, destinations), the product scope (a category and below, or the whole published assortment), whether images and products that cannot be bought now are included, a schedule for the feed job, and the active build. A feed is current from fromDate until thruDate (ending it stops serving); a change of its key fields is audit-logged and names its reason. A change of site, key, format or category clears the active build, which then needs a new one.

field.name: feedKey
field.description: The feed's name in its public path (feeds/{feedKey}.{extension} under the Shop mount): lower case letters, digits and hyphens, one current feed of a site each.

field.name: includeUnavailable
field.description: Y keeps a product that cannot be bought now (out of stock) as a row with its availability; otherwise it is a skip.

field.name: lastScheduledDate
field.description: When the feed job last built it.

entity.description: One build of a feed (build#StoreFeed, the feed job), never changed once written: complete (its artifact, digest, rows, skips and errors) or failed (its failure, no artifact; the feed's active build is left as it was). generation is the site's publication generation the build read; productIds are its rows' products, which serving re-checks against the resolver once the generation has moved on, so a product withdrawn after the build blocks the build until a rebuild without it is active.

field.name: builtByUserId
field.description: Empty for the feed job.

field.name: sampleJson
field.description: The first rows' public projection, for FeedPreview.
